Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function Style(f As Object) As String
Dim x As Variant,s As String
s="Font:"
For Each x In Array("Bold","Italic","Strikethrough","Underline","Color","ColorIndex","Name","Size")
s=s & CStr(x) & "=" & P(f.Font,CStr(x)) & ";"
Next
s=s & "Interior:"
For Each x In Array("Color","ColorIndex","Pattern","PatternColor","PatternColorIndex")
s=s & CStr(x) & "=" & P(f.Interior,CStr(x)) & ";"
Next
s=s & "NumberFormat=" & P(f,"NumberFormat")
For Each x In Array(xlEdgeLeft,xlEdgeTop,xlEdgeBottom,xlEdgeRight,xlInsideHorizontal,xlDiagonalDown)
s=s & "|Border" & x & ":Line=" & P(f.Borders(x),"LineStyle") & ";Weight=" & P(f.Borders(x),"Weight") & ";Color=" & P(f.Borders(x),"Color") & ";CI=" & P(f.Borders(x),"ColorIndex")
Next
Style=s
End Function
Function Rules() As String
Dim f As Object,s As String
s="count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
For Each f In Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";type=" & P(f,"Type") & ";op=" & P(f,"Operator")
Next
Rules=s
End Function

Function DirectBorder(f As Object,idx As Long) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=f.Borders(idx).LineStyle
If IsNull(v) Then
DirectBorder="Null(1)"
Else
DirectBorder=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
DirectBorder="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function B(f As Object,idx As Long) As String
B="index=" & idx & ";direct=" & DirectBorder(f,idx) & ";line=" & P(f.Borders(idx),"LineStyle") & ";weight=" & P(f.Borders(idx),"Weight") & ";color=" & P(f.Borders(idx),"Color") & ";CI=" & P(f.Borders(idx),"ColorIndex")
End Function
Function ApplyColor(f As Object,n As Long) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
f.Font.ColorIndex=n
ApplyColor="ci=" & n & ";color=" & P(f.Font,"Color") & ";getci=" & P(f.Font,"ColorIndex")
Exit Function
Failed:
ApplyColor="ci=" & n & ";ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function BorderStyle(f As Object,n As Long) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
f.Borders(xlBottom).LineStyle=n
BorderStyle="set=" & n & ";" & B(f,xlBottom)
Exit Function
Failed:
BorderStyle="set=" & n & ";ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function

Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,s As String,n As Long,x As Variant
Set f=Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlGreater,10)
ActiveSheet.Name="Source"
f.Modify Type:=xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0"
ActiveSheet.Copy After:=ActiveSheet
s="sheet=" & ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & Rules() & "|applies=" & ActiveSheet.Cells.FormatConditions(1).AppliesTo.Address
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Probe="ERR:" & n & "|" & Rules()
End Function
